provenance.description: PLANTED: the spec DECLARES a Re=200 2D-laminar envelope, but the parameters give U*L/nu = 25*1/0.01 = 2500 - above the Re_c approximately 1914 Hopf bifurcation and far outside the substrate's validated 2D-laminar envelope (Re_max ~200). The solver reports a 'converged steady' result, but max_Courant = 6.2 (>>1) marks it as a spurious steady state of an inherently unsteady, 3D-tending flow. The outcome reflects instrument limits, not the hypothesis.
provenance.authorship: hand-authored for the Step-20.7 triage battery; NOT a real run
provenance.expected_diagnosis: out_of_envelope - the run drifted outside the declared/validated envelope; the instrument cannot faithfully model this regime

chosen_hypothesis.statement: At a lid speed of 25 m/s the cavity reaches a steady recirculating state with a well-defined mean flow speed.
chosen_hypothesis.rationale: Extends the low-Re characterization to a much faster lid, assuming the same steady laminar structure persists.

experiment_spec.title: High-lid-speed cavity mean flow speed
experiment_spec.objective: Measure the steady-state volume-averaged flow speed of the cavity at a 25 m/s lid.

qoi.name: mean_flow_speed
qoi.definition: Volume-averaged velocity magnitude at the final time.
qoi.how_extracted: volAverage of mag(U) at the latest written time.

success_criterion.statement: The cavity reaches a steady state with mean flow speed above 3 m/s.

regime.notes: Declared as Re approximately 200, 2D steady laminar, inside the validated envelope (Re_max 200). NOTE the parameters: Re = U*L/nu = 25*1/0.01 = 2500.

mini_experiment.expected_observation: The flow reaches a steady recirculating state and the mean speed settles to a well-defined value.

fidelity_verdict.label: trust
fidelity_verdict.rationale: declared as a Re~200 laminar cavity (see the disclosed parameter note)

stage4_summaries.reason: reached endTime=20.0 with all final residuals < 0.001

expectation.note: U*L/nu = 25*1/0.01 = 2500, above the Re_c approximately 1914 Hopf bifurcation and far outside the substrate's 2D-laminar envelope (Re_max ~200). A 'converged steady' result with max_Courant 6.2 (>>1) is a numerical artifact of an instrument used out of envelope: out_of_envelope. more_data is the one wrong decision - finer runs of an out-of-envelope instrument do not help.
